Breakfast Run Sound Lab

Alternatives for each sound, so each one is clearly its own. A is the game today. B, C and D are played over the engine as it runs in a race, as the Spectrum’s effect player would play them. The figure on each is how much of a TV frame it takes while it sounds. Pick a letter for each.

Car crash

A

Today

The game as it is, recorded in a race.

11% of a frame

Low and heavy: a few widely spaced clicks that die away.

C

6% of a frame

A dense burst of noise that thins out.

D

Bang and rattle

6% of a frame

One loud bang, then three short rattles.
